law.catch_line: Firearms, training and usage; standards and requirements

text.section:
If a bail enforcement agent chooses to carry a firearm, either concealed or visible, in the course of his duties, he shall be required to:
First complete basic firearms training, as defined by the Board; and
Receive ongoing in-service firearms training, as defined by the Board.
In the event a bail enforcement agent discharges a firearm during the course of his duties, he shall report it to the Department within 24 business hours.
